summary.text: Benjamin Olsen is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 48 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Chad Behn.
An engineer, Olsen says in a Ballotpedia survey that he is focused on reducing nitrates in drinking water, public school funding and rural jobs.

paragraphs.text: Benjamin Olsen graduated from Roland-Story High School, earned an associate degree from Des Moines Area Community College in 2020 and a bachelor's degree from Iowa State University in 2025.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Olsen said he was born in Ames, studied aerospace engineering, and has worked as a product order engineer, a lubrication technician and a page in the 87th Iowa General Assembly.
Olsen defeated Daniel Wojcik and Guy Morgan in the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
He listed reducing nitrate levels in Iowa's drinking water, prioritizing public school funding over the state's voucher program, and expanding jobs in rural Iowa as his main messages.
